# Light bar

The DualSense® wireless controller has a light bar that wraps around the touchpad. You can set the color of the light bar to any RGB color value,  and control when the light bar activates.

For more information, refer to [Using the DualSense® Wireless Controller Light Bar Feature](https://game.develop.playstation.net/resources/documents/SDK/latest/Pad-Overview/using-the-light-bar-feature.html) (PlayStation®5 DevNet).

## Update the light bar color

To update the light bar color, use the following information:

* Use [`SetLightBarColor(Color)`](xref:UnityEngine.InputSystem.PS5.DualSenseGamepad.SetLightBarColor) to set the color of the light bar for the chosen controller. * Use [`ResetLightBarColor()`](xref:UnityEngine.InputSystem.PS5.DualSenseGamepad.ResetLightBarColor) to reset the light bar and turn it off.
